was: Private RV/tent/cabin resort (75 acres) near Rockwood (Somerset Co). Full hookups, 50-amp, wide level sites, big-rig friendly. Has a 5-acre fishing lake, but the lakeside units are covered-wagon rentals (RV sites not on the water). --Claude

was: Private family campground on the Upper Delaware River at Equinunk (Wayne Co), just above Kellam's Bridge. Partial-hookup short-term RV sites (W/E) + full-hookup seasonal; no weekday minimums. RV sites adjacent to the Delaware River. --Claude
note: Family campground on the Upper Delaware River at Equinunk (Wayne County), just above Kellam's Bridge.  Only ten sites suit RVs, for trailers up to 40 ft on narrow, uneven roads; the full-hookup sites are seasonal.  Priced per person plus a site fee ($22 an adult a night and $12 for water and electric on the operator's page headed '2023 Rates'); riverfront sites need at least 6 adults and creekside sites 4, and some RV sites carry a 3-adult minimum. --Claude

was: Private 28-acre campground near Elkins (Randolph Co), self-check-in (no office), online booking via Campspot. 13 full-hookup RV sites (30/50-amp) plus partial/primitive; in the National Radio Quiet Zone. Borders Chenoweth Creek but RV-site frontage not confirmed. --Claude

was: Private RV park (44 sites, 30/50-amp, city water, full sewer, shower house, laundry) at Clarksburg (Harrison Co). Oriented to long-term/worker stays but welcomes travelers passing through; bookable nightly via Campspot. Not waterfront. --Claude
note: Small, wooded RV park ten minutes from the west side of Clarksburg (Harrison County), pitched mainly at traveling workers on long stays but selling nightly sites year-round; all sites are back-ins.  Booked by phone: Campspot lists the park but had no sites to book on 2026-10-13, and no nightly rate is posted. --Claude

was: Raleigh County Parks & Recreation Authority park on 272-acre Lake Stephens (2,300-acre county park) near Beckley. 100 full-hookup pull-thru RV sites (30/50-amp) plus a separate tent campground, cabins, marina, beach; open May 1-Oct 31, reservations via Campspot. The RV loop is set back with lake views (lake access via marina/beach); RV sites tight/treeless. --Claude
note: Raleigh County park near Beckley on 272-acre Lake Stephens, with a marina, a beach, cabins and a separate tent campground.  The RV loop sits back from the lake; its sites are tight and treeless. --Claude

was: Perry Township (Lake County) park on Lake Erie. 30 RV sites w/ 30-amp electric + showers; sites on the lakefront bluff have Erie views. Day/week/month permits, online via Campspot. Open ~May-Nov; many seasonal but transient available. --Claude
note: Perry Township (Lake County) park on a Lake Erie bluff; the sites along the bluff look out over the lake.  Open roughly May to November; many sites are seasonal, but nightly sites are sold. --Claude
